text: A macro-enabled Office file in scope surfaces as a .xlsm/.docm/.dotm/.xlam TargetFilename in Sysmon EventCode 11, as SourceFileExtension in o365:management:activity, or as an email attachment; only the Sysmon route returned a malicious artifact (2 events: the emailed .xlsm and its Symantec quarantine copy).
The macro-enabled file in question is Frothly-Brewery-Financial-Planning-FY2019-Draft[66].xlsm (emailed to BruceGist and quarantined by Symantec as AP4D3C539B.xlsm), not Brewing.xlsm.
rival: Brewing.xlsm — the only other macro-enabled file in scope; ruled out because its single record is a benign FileAccessed by app@sharepoint (UserAgent=ExportWorker) with no Symantec detection or quarantine, whereas the Frothly-Brewery-Financial-Planning .xlsm was quarantined by Symantec.

text: Symantec's website lists the discovery date of Backdoor.PsEmpire as July 20, 2018 (07/20/18).
